title: Rho product bento
description: A 60px heading with a mint button on the right, then a three-column bento of 450px tinted cards (one, two or three columns wide): a mono label with an optional mint NEW chip, a 28px title, a muted line, and a screenshot panel rising from the card's bottom edge. Cards fade up one after another; on phones they become a sideways rail with arrows.
notes: media: one screenshot per card; empty: an inset panel with a hairline, flush to the card's bottom
size 1/2/3 = columns on desktop; on phones cards of size 2 and 3 are twice as wide in the rail
needs JavaScript for the phone rail's arrows (hydrate: visible)
name: rho-bento
